svg.title: T. Web development, AI automation, hardware and video.
svg.desc: T. Web development, AI automation, hardware and video. Yes, the websites, architectures, and databases you see here were built by AI, but designed by me, through my architectural decisions, under my lead.

g.text: AI is a tool, chaos, and science.
Luckily for my job, it lacks taste.
I build local AI tools, self-hosted apps
and workflows for coding agents. I also
test PC hardware and edit video.
